themes.topic: CXL DRAM pooling impact on eSSD capacity in AI clusters
themes.summary: The expansion of CXL DRAM pooling raises questions about how much data currently stored on eSSDs could shift to DRAM, potentially affecting the total eSSD capacity and the mix of high-performance and high-capacity drives needed for AI clusters.

mentions.text:

themes.topic: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash throughput on GB300 GPUs
themes.summary: A critique of ZeroHedge's ROIC calculation highlights that DeepSeek v4.1 Flash models can achieve 8x-10x higher output token throughput per GPU on a GB300 compared to the 2700 output tokens/s used in the calculation.
